full_prompt_en: A square painted graphic-novel scene shows a solitary masked traveler resting against a rough yellow-green masonry wall. The person sits low at the left, occupying the vertical corner where the lit wall meets an enormous dark metal door. A long ochre coat with a tall turned-up collar hangs from shoulder to near the ground, concealing most of the torso and arms. Beneath it, one bent leg in gray trousers rests forward, ending in a worn brown lace-up boot planted on the pale floor. The head is covered by a dark rounded helmet or respirator with one small glowing yellow circular lens facing right. No face or eyes can otherwise be seen. The heavy door fills the right half and more of the frame. It is nearly black blue-green, with horizontal and vertical seams, rivets, and a curled metal fitting near the center. Cracked blocks and stained plaster remain visible on the wall at left; their yellow light contrasts with the door's cold darkness. The floor is a narrow warm strip along the bottom, with dirt and worn brush marks. The traveler seems to wait rather than act, body folded into the corner and head angled toward the closed door. Strong shape contrast defines the composition: an ochre wedge, yellow circle, dark rectangular door, and rough masonry vertical. Fine surface hatching and scuffed paint distinguish cloth, boot leather, stone, and metal. The viewpoint is at roughly seated eye level, making the door loom above the figure. No other people, setting beyond the doorway, or readable text appear. The mood is lonely and speculative, conveyed by industrial scale, restrained color, and the hidden face.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式图像小说场景描绘孤独戴面罩的旅人靠着粗糙黄绿砌墙休息。人物坐在左下，处于亮墙与巨大暗金属门相接的竖向角落。一件高翻领赭黄长外套从肩垂至近地面，遮住大部分躯干与手臂。外套下，一条穿灰裤的弯腿向前伸，磨旧棕色系带靴踩在浅色地板上。头被深色圆头盔或呼吸面罩罩住，只有一个朝右的小黄圆镜片发光。除此看不到脸或眼。沉重的门填满右半及更多画面，近黑蓝绿，有横竖拼缝、铆钉和中央附近卷曲金属配件。左墙仍见开裂砖块和污渍灰泥，黄光与门的冷暗相对。地面只是一条沿底边的暖色窄带，带泥土和磨损笔痕。旅人似乎在等待而非行动，身体蜷进墙角，头朝闭门倾斜。强形状对比界定构图：赭黄楔形、黄圆点、暗矩形门和粗砌墙竖线。细表面排线与擦损颜料区分布、靴皮、石和金属。视点大致是坐姿眼高，让门高耸于人物之上。没有其他人、门后场景或可读文字。气氛孤独而富想象性，由工业尺度、克制色彩与隐藏面孔传达。
style_prompt_en: The painted graphic-novel treatment sets a small warm ochre silhouette against monumental blue-black industrial planes. A rough yellow-green lit wall provides one vertical counterweight, while a single tiny circular glow punctuates the dark. Brush grain, scuffs, fine hatching, rivets, and worn seams give stone, fabriclike folds, and metal distinct tactile surfaces. Forms are broad and simple at a distance but reveal detailed weathering close up. The figure is compressed into a lower corner, making negative dark space feel heavy and imposing. Lighting is localized and muted, with no glossy spectacle. The palette stays narrow—ochre, mustard, olive, teal charcoal, and warm gray—and the still composition feels patient, lonely, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式图像小说处理把小小暖赭剪影置于巨大的蓝黑工业平面前。粗糙黄绿受光墙成为一处竖向平衡，一枚极小圆光刺破暗色。笔触颗粒、擦痕、细排线、铆钉和磨旧拼缝使石、织物般褶与金属各有可触表面。远看形体宽阔简单，近看显露细致风化。主体被压进下方角落，使深暗留白显得沉重高压。照明局部而压低，没有光滑炫耀。色盘狭窄，只用赭、芥黄、橄榄、青炭与暖灰；静止构图耐心、孤独且具电影感。
theme_en: A masked traveler in a long ochre coat sits beside a dark industrial doorway
theme_zh: 戴面罩、穿赭黄长外套的旅人坐在深色工业门洞旁
name: Travis Charest
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
